_why: THE PLUGIN SPEC, pinned from both ends (round 224). Every other payload-bearing route the panel parses has a fixture (boot-history, monitor-row, session-row, status, vitals-series); this one did not. The panel renders `displayName` in its side rail (ContextRail.tsx) and matches it in the plugins search (PluginsPage.tsx), so a rename on the device side empties the labels with nothing to see — the failure monitor-row.json's own _why describes: 'a wrong guess looks like data'. `required_by_panel` is the list read off the panel's `SpecPlugin` interface; the device asserts it SENDS every one of them, and the panel's test asserts it READS them.
